adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `topic_id` is nil it renders `loading` (HTTP 200) and still calls `discourse_expires_in 1.minute`. The loading template (`app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`) auto-reloads after 30s, but because the response is cached for 60s, the reload can repeatedly receive the same cached loading HTML until cache expiry, delaying the real content and effectively looping on stale HTML for up to a minute.
